• Effective verbal and written communication skills to articulate test results and collaborate with team members.

• Professional certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) or CSTE (Certified Software Tester) are advantageous.

result.description:
Electronics Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA 

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufacture high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for an Electronics Engineer in our Thornton NSW Office.

Purpose of this position:
Assist in the day-to-day operation of Electronics production, sales and repairs for Nepean Power Electronics.
Knowledge of the Nepean product range and assisting in the production, testing, maintenance and support of these products. Liaise with customers, Nepean Power workshop and external suppliers giving product support.
Issuing and receiving purchase and sales orders. Understand the concepts and requirements of intrinsic safety and manage documentation to support its application.

KEY RESULT AREAS:

WHS:
To work in a safe manner using and developing appropriate SWMS, Risk Assessments or Safety Operating
Procedures as required.
To notify supervisor or safety committee delegate immediately of any hazards in the workplace and to monitor or implement any actions taken to correct hazards to ensure that the hazard is removed from the workplace.
Take all reasonable care for the health and safety of yourself, others and the environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Assistance and support to the Electronics Manager:
Organize procure of required raw materials/stock for product build.
Raising purchase orders, receiving goods and processing sales orders
Assembly, manufacture and testing of Nepean Power products
Testing product firmware
Supervision of technicians and manage production scheduling to achieve the above
Customer equipment inspection, repairs and testing
Conduct and manage documentation to ensure compliance with NP standards, procedures and policies.
Workshop and site support
Assist in research and development as required.
On the job training will be provided as well as any formal internal or external training deemed necessary

General Company Roles
As Electronics is a growing department, there may be occasions where team members may be required to perform duties outside of their regular job description.

EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
TAFE Cert III in Electronics, Electrical or similar field, Graduate Electrical/ Electronics Engineer

Skills, knowledge & abilities:
Understanding of fundamental electrical and electronic theories.
Practical experience with electronic and mechanical design and assembly
Excellent communication skills
Experience preferred but not required.
Excellent documentation ability
Some experience with programming is desirable but not a requirement

Leadership Competencies (if supervising others):
Drive Electronics Production
Self-motivated
Training and coaching technicians, apprentices and trainees

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 per annum + Super

Install structures or fixtures, including windows, doors, frames, flooring, trim, and hardware, using hand and power tools.

This position is offered on a minimum 2-year contract with the possibility of further extension.

Responsibilities include:

•	Install structures or fixtures, such as windows, doors, frames, floorings, trim, or hardware, using hand or power tools.

result.description: Surf Coast IT Solutions Pty Ltd  Trading as EDUVERIFI  As a Business Analyst, you will act as a vital link between business and technology teams by identifying, analysing, and translating business requirements to support the successful delivery of digital products and platforms. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across marketing, product, and technology functions to drive effective solutions and achieve strategic business outcomes.   Benefits   Diverse work across projects, implementations, support, and product improvement  Learning and development opportunities  Supportive team culture and collaborative environment  Career growth opportunities within a growing software business  Meaningful involvement in delivering successful customer outcomes    Task & responsibilities   Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions to support business decision-making.   Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.   Prepare meaningful reports and visualisations tailored to stakeholder requirements.   Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather, analyse, and document business requirements.   Develop and deliver Business Intelligence solutions aligned with organisational objectives.   Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning and operational improvements.   Review existing business systems, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for enhancement.   Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand operational challenges and recommend effective solutions.   Design, implement, and maintain ETL processes to ensure accurate and efficient data integration.   Collaborate with international teams to customise BI solutions for diverse business environments and markets.   Ensure BI systems and reporting frameworks remain scalable, efficient, and adaptable.   Utilise tools such as SSIS, Power Automate, and Azure Data Factory to automate and streamline data processes.   Drive process improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce manual intervention.   Present complex analytical findings in a clear and understandable manner to non-technical stakeholders.   Develop presentations and reports that convert data insights into practical business strategies.           Qualification & experience   At least 1 years of experience in a Business Intelligence or Data Analytics role, preferably within the logistics or freight forwarding sector.   Demonstrated experience working for international freight forwarding organisations in an analytical capacity.   Advanced expertise in Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualisation.   Hands-on experience with CargoWise One software.   Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.   Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Azure, SQL, Python, or related technologies.   Strong understanding of cloud-based platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.   Proven experience in ETL development and data integration tools, including SSIS and Azure Data Factory.   Working knowledge of Power Automate and workflow automation technologies.   Experience working with multinational teams and clients across different countries, cultures, and business environments will be highly regarded.   About Company     Surf Coast IT Solutions  is a Geelong-based technology firm operating at the intersection of identity verification, education technology, and mobile and cloud-based application development. The company combines a services arm — websites, custom applications, and managed IT — with a portfolio of proprietary EdTech products positioned for the Australian regulated training market and beyond. Our flagship product,  EduVerifi , is one of a small number of Australian platforms holding live integrations with both  IDMatch Australia  (RapidID gateway) and  DigiLocker India , alongside  IELTS  and  PTE  verification through the British Council and Pearson Academic. This regulatory positioning forms the foundation of a defensible moat in a market where compliance is the barrier to entry. Surf Coast IT Solutions is wholly Australian-owned, founder-operated, and profitable through its services arm, which funds ongoing product development.
